confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from Marseille cost-of-living and menu listing snippets, not official price indexes or opened pages. Beer is the least certain because no demi-specific terrace price was found, and the cocktail and wine anchors rest partly on individual venue listings. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for the July high season; no accommodation searches or booking pages were used. EUR figures were converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR, which was not searched. The FX rate comes from search-result text citing the RBA exchange rates statistics page for 16 October 2026; I did not open that page directly, and the 16 October observation may be published late in the day.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Marseille-specific price data. Accommodation anchors are a holistic estimate from general knowledge of mid-sized French Mediterranean port cities, adjusted for July high season.
